job.rawText: About The CompanyA fast-growing digital health platform focused on diabetes and weight management, helping hundreds of thousands of members manage chronic conditions through connected devices, coaching, and a consumer app. Backed by leading healthcare-focused investors, the company is scaling its consumer experience across India and international markets.The RoleWe're looking for a senior, hands-on brand and UX leader to shape how the company shows up — visually, verbally, and experientially — across product and marketing. This is an individual contributor role for someone who wants to lead through craft and judgment rather than headcount: setting the brand vision and design direction, then rolling up their sleeves to execute at a high bar.RequirementsWhat You'll DoOwn end-to-end brand identity — voice, visual language, and positioning — across the app, website, and marketing channelsLead UX strategy and design for key consumer journeys, from onboarding to chronic care engagement, balancing clinical trust with everyday usabilityPartner closely with product, marketing, and clinical teams to translate business and health outcomes into intuitive, well-designed experiencesEstablish and evolve design systems, brand guidelines, and UX standards as the company scalesBring an external point of view on category trends in consumer health, wellness, and behavior-change designWhat We're Looking For10+ years of experience spanning brand and UX/product design, ideally with senior individual-contributor experience at a consumer tech, D2C, or digital health companyA strong portfolio demonstrating both brand craft (identity, storytelling, visual systems) and UX rigor (research-informed, outcome-driven design)Comfort operating at both strategic and execution levels — equally at ease presenting a brand vision to leadership and shipping a redesigned flowExperience in healthcare, wellness, or behavior-change products is a strong plus, but not mandatorySomeone who wants ownership and impact without managing a large teamBenefitsWhy JoinHigh-ownership IC role with direct influence on product and brand directionWork on a mission-driven product improving health outcomes for a large, underserved populationBacked by healthcare-focused investors with a strong founder-market fit and growth trajectory Show more Show less

Build with us Explore opportunities and work with us Join us BabyMD Comprehensive, end-to-end, paediatric care for the new-age parents Founder Deeksha Senguttuvan Year 2024 From outpatient consultations to vaccinations, lactation support, and developmental assessment and therapies, BabyMD's experienced team ensures every child's health and development are in expert hands. With pediatric expertise, BabyMD provides round-the-clock access to trusted pediatricians through 24x7 chat, video consultations, and in-clinic consultations. www.babymd.in Elevate Now India's first doctor-led weight loss program that combines medication & coaching for sustainable weight loss Founder Suryansh Kumar Year 2022 Elevate Now is India’s first obesity doctor-led, medication-based weight loss program that combines medicines with personalized health and habit coaching. The company is fundamentally revolutionizing the way India understands and treats weight. www.joinelevatenow.com Nivaan Care India’s first end-to-end pain management clinic that uses the gold standard in care protocols Founder Nivesh Khandelwal, Vishwas Singh Year 2023 Nivaan is building India’s first asset-light, single specialty chain of pain management clinics. It uses a holistic biopsychosocial approach which addresses the underlying cause of pain, thereby leading to significant improvements in efficacy over traditional methods. www.nivaancare.com Reveal Healthtech Enabling digital ambitions of healthcare companies in the US by providing engineering, clinical and strategic expertise Founder Sanchit Mullick Year 2023 Reveal HealthTech provides cross-functional technology services and talent augmentation to healthcare companies with its engineering, clinical, and strategic support, and aims to partner with US-based healthcare organizations to maximize patient health... https://revealhealthtech.com/ Nivesh Khandelwal Nivaan Care Nivesh is an accomplished 3rd time entrepreneur. In the past, he has managed a leading IVF chain in Delhi and has worked in P&L roles across consumer and retail businesses. He has previously started his own F&B business (which he exited to the Future group) and has also started a healthcare fintech start-up. He has a degree in engineering from UCLA and an MBA from Wharton.Nivesh brings his detailed understanding of Indian healthcare and his analytical skills to build India’s largest pain brand with Nivaan. Previous Next Sanchit Mullick Reveal Healthtech Sanchit is a senior growth & service delivery leader with 20+ years of experience across technology products and services industries. He has managed $100M+ P&L across tech giants like Global Logic, SAP and Infosys. He is an engineer from NIT Bhopal and has an MBA degree from IIM Lucknow.At Reveal, he leverages his extensive experience with front-end tech sales to large global clients whilst managing delivery teams out of India. Previous Next Suryansh Kumar Elevate Now Suryansh is an experienced business leader with a background in consumer start-ups like Dukaan, Swiggy, Snapdeal, Shuttl, POPxo. He has driven user experience and implemented innovative initiatives at Swiggy, such as b2b lending and restaurant supplies. Suryansh has also managed growth and implemented loyalty programs and subscription-based selling at Snapdeal and Shuttl. In his previous role at Dukaan, he successfully launched and scaled last-mile logistics and core subscription revenue. Previous Next Vishwas Singh Nivaan Care Vishwas is an exceptionally skilled and seasoned entrepreneur, boasting a diverse background that spans across various sectors and organizational stages.He has held pivotal roles including operations and supply chain head, product co-owner, P&L owner, legal expert, and head of public policy and PR. He has worked in fin-tech, health-tech, mobility, e-commerce, payments, and logistics sectors, contributing to startups and corporates like TATA1mg, Shuttl, PayU, and Healthkart. Vishwas co-founded BundleBaazi, revolutionizing the Indian shopping experience. He is driven by a passion for delivering quality healthcare to the most impacted individuals in India. Previous Next Bhavesh Hemani Group CFO Bhavesh has more than 18 years of experience of working in financial services industry. He has worked with PE & VC funds like Actis, Lok Capital and Education Catalyst Fund. He started his professional journey at Deloitte in its Audit & Assurance division from where he moved to Global Private Equity fund, Actis Capital. He was Director-Finance at Lok Capital, where he spent 8 years and was responsible for fund operations, deal execution, structuring, reporting and investor relations. Bhavesh is a Chartered Accountant from Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and has completed Level 1 of CFA program. Previous Next Dan Judd Head of US Incubations leads U.S. Ventures at 2070 Health and W Health Ventures, bringing deep expertise in building venture studios and scaling healthcare companies. Previously, Dan was a founding executive at Fractal Software, a venture studio building vertical SaaS businesses. At Fractal, he oversaw the entire portfolio post incorporation. Fractal went on to launch of over 130 companies with nearly $1B in external capital invested across the portfolio. Previously, Dan was an early team member at Carbon Health, a tech-enabled healthcare provider, where he launched and scaled several high-growth care divisions—including virtual care, clinical research, and primary care—each generating millions in revenue. Dan holds dual bachelor's degrees from the University of Pennsylvania in Business (Wharton) and Computer Science (Engineering), and an MBA from Stanford. Previous Next Dr. Nikhil Hegde Head, New Ventures Dr. Nikhil Hegde studied medicine from Nair Hospital in Mumbai, India. He went on to pursue an MBA in Strategy and Finance at IIM Calcutta where he graduated top 15 of his class. Prior to joining W Health Ventures, he worked as a consultant at Bain & company advising some of the leading pharmaceutical companies and hospital networks in India and the Middle East. His work spanned across due diligence, strategy and project management in oncology, women's health, critical care and digital health. Previous Next Dr. Pankaj Jethwani Chief Executive Officer Dr. Jethwani has spearheaded transformative advancements in healthcare across the US and India. As a physician leader, operator, consultant, and investor, he has elevated care delivery standards. Witnessing firsthand the gaps in healthcare, he joined forces with The Boston Consulting Group, shaping government initiatives for scalable healthcare improvements. He also co-founded The Breakfast Revolution, in an attempt to battle India's malnutrition epidemic. With a focus on disrupting the healthcare landscape, he made significant contributions at Iora Health and now leads the charge at 2070 Health, revolutionizing healthcare in India. Previous Next Gaurav Porwal Chief Operating Officer Gaurav Porwal serves as the Operating Partner at W Health Ventures and the Chief Operating Officer at 2070 Health. In his role, Gaurav leads portfolio management, collaborating closely with founders and operating teams to drive the success of 2070 Health’s portfolio companies. An alumnus of IIT-B and ISB, Gaurav brings two decades of founder and senior leadership experience in the Indian startup ecosystem. He has a proven track record of building and scaling businesses, including a successful exit from Sparsh NephroCare, acquired by Fresenius Medical Care in 2016. Gaurav’s extensive experience spans multiple consumer and healthcare ventures, including his roles as COO of Global Mobility at Ola and SVP of Service Commerce at Tata Digital, where he built businesses across healthcare, food delivery, and mobility for Tata Group's super-app, Tata Neu. Previous Next Yashwant Kumar Chief Growth Officer Yashwant Kumar brings 18 years of leadership across Consumer Tech, E-commerce, and FMCG, with deep expertise in entrepreneurship, marketing, and global strategy. He began his career at Procter & Gamble, leading iconic brands like Pantene and Pringles across Asia and the US, sparking a passion for digital-led brand growth. He later co-founded and scaled a top-tier performance marketing & martech agency to 100+ people, driving growth for large hospitals, early stage healthtech start-ups, and consumer brands. He went on to build India's first high-speed electric scooter charging network at Ola Electric, and at Tata Digital, led omnichannel strategy and scaled user growth for the Tata Neu super app. Now at 2070 Health, Yashwant partners with portfolio founders to craft integrated brand and growth strategies that fast-track go-to-market success. An alumnus of IIT Bombay, he holds a B.Tech in Chemical Engineering. Previous Next Build with us Become a founder to a company that drives scale & impact in healthcare Thank you for Submitting

A Venture Studio building healthcare companies from scratch Vision & mission Improving patient lives at scale Healthcare in India is a broken experience for most patients. Challenges of access, quality of care and non-holistic solutions exist across patient demographics At 2070 Health, we aim to strike at the heart of the problem by addressing the challenges that hinder innovation in this industry and solve for the massive white spaces We are India’s first Venture Studio building patient-centric healthcare companies from scratch by bringing together futuristic ideas, exceptional founders, and a powerful innovation platform Build with us We believe healthcare is a human right and are committed to launching innovative ventures that transform lives and uplift communities Studio process Building a series of ventures from concept to scale Our proven 4-step process lets us replicate success across ventures. Through research-driven concepts and an expert-led approach, we’re able to build and scale sustainable companies Step 1 Ideation & deep validation We discover disruptive opportunities through fundamental research and deep diligence. We kill 90% ideas with conviction through a structured research process, and introducing several stage gates before the idea sees the light of day ​ Step 2 Team Building We set the business up for success by bringing in exceptional founders and early team. We are building India's largest talent universe with thousands of potential founders, to create a pipeline of rockstar business leaders Step 3 Launch We expedite growth via our powerful Innovation Platform: technology stack, omnichannel GTM capabilities, marketing expertise, talent ecosystem, powerful partnerships, and capital​ Step 4 Scale Up We leverage functional playbooks across Tech, Growth, Marketing, Finance, Legal & Regulatory, etc. to support growth, till the company reaches maturity​ Studio process Building a series of ventures from concept to scale Our proven 4-step process lets us replicate success across ventures. Through research-driven concepts and an expert-led approach, we’re able to build and scale sustainable companies Step 1 Ideation & deep validation We discover disruptive opportunities through fundamental research and deep diligence. We kill 90% ideas with conviction through a structured research process, and introducing several stage gates before the idea sees the light of day ​ Step 2 Team Building We set the business up for success by bringing in exceptional founders and early team. We are building India's largest talent universe with thousands of potential founders, to create a pipeline of rockstar business leaders Step 3 Launch We expedite growth via our powerful Innovation Platform: technology stack, omnichannel GTM capabilities, marketing expertise, talent ecosystem, powerful partnerships, and capital​ Step 4 Scale Up We leverage functional playbooks across Tech, Growth, Marketing, Finance, Legal & Regulatory, etc. to support growth, till the company reaches maturity​ Our Values Innovation. Impact. Healthcare. Respect We will treat each other with respect. Every individual will be valued for their unique contributions and everyone will be treated with fairness, and compassion Honesty We will be honest in our words and actions --- do right by others, have a backbone, and speak up Action We will have an insatiable, no-nonsense drive for action and accountability. We will take prompt and decisive actions in the face of uncertainty or ambiguity Collaboration We recognize that our vision of transforming healthcare is a monumental one, and cannot be achieved by individual efforts until we leverage the power of the team Positivity We will stay focused, agile, and positive even in tough times. We will learn from failures, and will be relentless in our pursuit of excellence. Giving up is never an option Innovation We will ideate & innovate with boldness & courage as we venture on ‘the road not taken’ Contact us Time to build in healthcare is now Want to start a company with us? job.rawText: Designation: Business Head — Sales & Transaction Advisory Nature of Role: Vertical head. You are being hired to build a new business line, not to join an existing one. Reports To: Board of Directors, Schnell Builders Pvt. Ltd. Base Location: Gurugram (with travel to Goa, Bangalore & mandate locations) Team: Build from zero. Target 6–12 in Year 1, scaling with mandate wins. Experience: Minimum 10 years in real estate / property sales Employment Type: Full-time, on-roll Compensation: Best in industry — market-benchmarked fixed CTC + uncapped sales incentive + profit share on the verticalABOUT SCHNELL BUILDERSSchnell Builders is an EPC and pre-engineered buildings company with a delivered portfolio across airports, institutional, commercial, residential and office projects. Our marquee execution credential is the Ayodhya Airport, delivered under contract with the Airports Authority of India.Schnell is now a developer. Our active pipeline includes Corgao Private Estates (a 40-villa luxury township on approx. 42 acres in North Goa near Mopa Airport), Schnell Sucorro (a boutique stacked-villa community in Bardez, North Goa), and premium builder floors at DLF Phase 2, Gurugram.We are now establishing a dedicated Sales & Transaction Advisory vertical as a standalone business line — selling Schnell's own inventory and securing exclusive sales mandates for third-party developers and land owners. This role is being created to build and lead that vertical.THE MANDATE A two-part role. Both parts matter equally.Mandate A — Sell Schnell's Own InventoryOwn the sales number for all Schnell inventory: luxury villas in Goa, builder floors at DLF Phase 2, and future launches.Set launch strategy, pricing ladders, inventory phasing and payment plan design with the Directors.Personally close high-value transactions with HNI, UHNI, NRI and institutional buyers.Own absorption velocity, realised price per sq. ft., collections and receivable ageing.Mandate B — Build the Sales & Transaction Advisory VerticalWrite the charter for the vertical — what we sell, for whom, at what commercials — and execute it after Board approval.Originate and win exclusive sales mandates from third-party developers, land owners and asset holders across residential, villa, plotted, commercial and land transactions.Negotiate mandate terms: exclusivity, brokerage rate, minimum guaranteed offtake, marketing cost sharing, price protection and termination. Protect Schnell's downside in every mandate.Run the vertical as a P&L — own revenue, cost base, break-even and margin.Build the unit economics: brokerage income per mandate, cost per qualified site visit, cost of sale as % of booking value, payback per hire.Secure and maintain RERA agent registration in every state the vertical transacts (Haryana, Goa, Karnataka and others as required).Design and enforce the internal wall between Schnell's own inventory and third-party mandate inventory — a governance obligation, not a formality.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESExclusive Mandate Origination — Build a target list of developers, land owners and slow-moving projects across NCR, Goa, Bangalore and select secondary markets. Pitch at promoter/CXO level. Conduct pre-mandate diligence and walk away from mandates that will fail. Own delivery of every mandate signed.Team Building & Vertical Leadership — Design the org structure from first principles, justify every hire against a revenue or margin line. Recruit, onboard, ramp the team. Set the operating cadence — daily huddles, weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly resets. Build the incentive plan that retains top performers. Build a bench of two credible successors.High-Value Deal Closure — Personally originate, negotiate and close large-ticket transactions across Schnell and mandated inventory through to registration. Structure tranche-based payments, buyback/assured-return propositions and portfolio exits. Be the person a stuck ₹5 Cr+ deal escalates to — and stops at.Channel Partner & Distribution Network — Build and formalise a channel partner network across NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore and Goa. Establish relationships with organised broking houses and national channel platforms. Own NRI and outstation lead channels for Goa.Presales, CRM & Process — Enforce CRM discipline (Salesforce, Zoho, Sell.Do or equivalent). Build the presales engine: qualification scripts, response SLAs, site-visit conversion tracking, lead-source ROI. Deliver a weekly MIS to the Board.Compliance & Cross-Functional Coordination — Ensure RERA disclosure compliance. Coordinate with Projects/EPC teams and Finance on collections and payouts. Represent Schnell at industry forums and expos.MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS Candidates who do not meet every criterion will not be shortlisted.Minimum 10 years full-time real estate/property sales experience, with at least 4 years in a leadership capacity carrying a team target.Demonstrable experience leading a sales team of 5+, with direct ownership of targets, reviews, incentives and outcomes.Verifiable track record of personally closing high-ticket transactions — units of ₹3 Cr+, or bulk/commercial deals of ₹10 Cr+ — with substantial cumulative booking value.Meaningful tenure (ideally 3+ years) with a recognised Grade-A developer (DLF, Godrej Properties, Sobha, Prestige, Embassy, Lodha, Hiranandani, M3M, Signature Global, Emaar or comparable) OR a top-tier consultancy (JLL, CBRE, Knight Frank, Colliers, Cushman & Wakefield, Anarock or comparable).Experience building a sales team from a standing start — not only inheriting one.Experience running a sales business as a P&L, or credible readiness on the cost side.Experience originating, negotiating or delivering exclusive sales mandates for third-party developers or asset owners.PREFERRED (NOT DISQUALIFYING)Luxury villa/second-home/resort-residential exposure (Goa, Alibaug, Kasauli or comparable);An established NRI/HNI buyer network; relationships into developer promoters and land owners; Experience with an EPC-to-developer transition; MBA in Marketing/Sales/General Management (bachelor's required regardless); Working knowledge of RERA and TCP Goa zoning; Fluency in English and Hindi.KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Scorecard A (Schnell Inventory): bookings value, collections, realised price per sq. ft., absorption velocity. Scorecard B (The Vertical): mandates won (number and GDV), brokerage income, vertical margin, break-even timeline, mandate delivery vs. commitment, cost of sale as % of booking value, team health, channel strength.COMPENSATION & BENEFITSMarket rate, benchmarked against published 2026 VP/Head-of-Sales data for Indian real estate and Delhi-NCR sales leadership.Fixed CTC: ₹30,00,000–₹45,00,000 p.a.Sales Incentive (Schnell inventory): 0.15%–0.30% of booking value, paid on collection, uncapped with accelerators.Mandate Incentive: 5%–10% of realised brokerage income.Vertical Profit Share: 10%–15% of vertical PBT, post break-even.On-Target Earnings: ₹50,00,000–₹70,00,000 p.a. at 100% plan achievement.Benefits: travel, communication reimbursement, statutory benefits, annual review.Roughly 40% of on-plan earnings sit in variable — deliberate by design. Incentives are paid on cash realised, not bookings signed; cancellations/defaults are subject to clawback. The band is a guide, not a ceiling — an exceptional candidate with a demonstrable HNI book or live mandate leads will be considered above it. This is the founding hire for a business line, positioned to grow into a Business Head mandate with long-term participation as the vertical scales.WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT FORNot a role where pre-qualified leads and a brand name close deals for you. Not a role where the process, team, mandates and channel network already exist — none of them do. Not for someone who has managed a team on paper without carrying the consequence of the number.It is a role for someone who wants to build a sales business, own its economics, and be paid on what it earns.HOW TO APPLY Share your CV with a one-page note covering:The largest single transaction you have personally closed — project, value, your role.The largest team you have built and led, the target it carried, and what it delivered.Any experience winning or delivering an exclusive third-party sales mandate.A first view (3–4 lines) on how you would win Schnell's first exclusive mandate.Applications without the covering note will not be reviewed.Apply to: hr@schnellbuilder.com Subject: Business Head, Sales — [Your Name] — [Years of Experience] Show more Show less

Ltd.Job Type: Full-Time | OnsiteExperience: Relevant experience in Operations / Project Management / Team ManagementSalary: Competitive / As per experience About the Role Artificilux VN Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Chief Operating Officer (COO) / Operations Manager to take ownership of the company’s day-to-day operations and ensure smooth execution across departments, timely project delivery, strong team performance, exceptional client experience and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will be a strong operations and people leader who can independently identify and resolve operational issues, coordinate multiple departments, manage priorities, monitor performance and ensure that the company operates efficiently without unnecessary dependence on senior leadership. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the complete day-to-day operations of the company. Conduct and coordinate daily operations meetings and ensure clear task allocation. Coordinate across departments, Project Managers and team members. Manage workflows, resource allocation, SOP implementation and process improvement. Ensure timely project completion and client delivery. Handle client issues, escalations, delivery planning and client experience. Monitor client health, satisfaction and retention. Track team performance, productivity, attendance, discipline and daily follow-ups. Resolve team conflicts and ensure effective internal coordination. Manage project priorities, deadlines, workload distribution and operational risks. Monitor quality and ensure consistent standards across projects. Drive business improvement initiatives, service improvement and process innovation. Support client growth, account expansion and collaboration planning. Coordinate hiring, interviews, onboarding, training and employee performance reviews. Manage ClickUp, dashboards, KPIs, daily reporting and operational documentation. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports for leadership. Coordinate closely with management and participate in business reviews and execution planning. Take operational decisions within assigned authority and resolve issues before unnecessary escalation. Key Performance Areas The role will be evaluated on: On-time Project Delivery Client Retention & Satisfaction Team Productivity Employee Retention Project Completion Rate SOP & Process Compliance Task Completion Rate Quality Score Operational Efficiency Hiring & Onboarding Efficiency Reduction in Founder Dependency What We’re Looking For Strong leadership and operational management skills. Ability to manage multiple teams, projects and priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Excellent coordination and communication skills. Ability to handle client and team escalations professionally. Strong understanding of project delivery, deadlines, workflows and resource planning. Ability to build accountability and maintain team discipline. Process-oriented mindset with a focus on SOPs, systems and continuous improvement. Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of operational responsibilities. Comfortable working with project-management systems, dashboards and performance metrics. Daily Responsibilities The COO / Operations Manager will be responsible for reviewing active clients and projects, tracking pending tasks and delivery timelines, resolving client and team issues, coordinating with Project Managers and department heads, monitoring KPIs and ClickUp dashboards, ensuring resource availability and submitting daily operational reports to leadership. Success in This Role The successful candidate will ensure that daily operations run smoothly without constant Founder intervention, clients receive timely delivery and a premium experience, teams remain productive and coordinated, issues are resolved quickly, projects are delivered on time with consistent quality, and continuous process improvements are implemented. The ultimate objective is to allow the Founder to focus primarily on strategy, growth and major business opportunities rather than daily operations. Apply Now Interested candidates can share their CV along with a brief summary of their relevant operations/team management experience at: career@artificiluxvn.com Artificilux VN Pvt. Ltd. Branding | PR | Media | Content & Digital Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month Benefits: Flexible schedule Internet reimbursement Leave encashment Paid sick time Work from home Work Location: In person

job.rawText: CRM Operations SpecialistJob Type: ContractorLocation: RemoteJob OverviewWe are seeking experienced CRM Operations Specialists to contribute to a project focused on optimizing sales operations and customer relationship management processes.In this role, you will apply your practical expertise in CRM platforms, sales processes, automation, and data management to help improve next-generation AI systems. You will provide real-world insights, evaluate workflows, review CRM data, and validate AI-generated outputs against practical sales operations scenarios.No prior AI experience is required—your CRM and sales operations expertise is what matters most.Scope of WorkEvaluate and provide expert input on CRM workflows, sales processes, pipeline management, and automation logic using platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and similar tools. Document existing sales operations processes, identifying workflow inefficiencies, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Provide real-world CRM scenarios, examples, and feedback based on industry best practices in sales operations and enablement. Review, analyze, and annotate CRM records, data, workflows, and user interactions to support AI training objectives. Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with real-world sales and CRM operations. Review and contribute to documentation, process guides, training materials, and other CRM-related content. Assess CRM data quality and identify inconsistencies, duplication, missing information, and process gaps. Provide actionable recommendations for improving CRM adoption, workflow efficiency, automation, and sales process consistency. Collaborate with project teams and reviewers to refine CRM-related datasets, scenarios, and AI evaluation criteria. job.rawText: Join Data Eminence as a remote Digital Marketing Specialist and help grow our online presence through data-driven marketing strategies and engaging digital campaigns. You'll work across search, social media, content, email, and performance marketing while analyzing campaign results and identifying opportunities for growth. This role is ideal for entry-level candidates with strong communication skills, creativity, analytical thinking, and an interest in digital marketing.Full DescriptionData Eminence is seeking a motivated Digital Marketing Specialist to join our growing marketing team. In this role, you will support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing campaigns across multiple online channels.You will collaborate with content, design, business development, product, and sales teams to create campaigns that increase brand awareness, audience engagement, website traffic, and business growth. This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience with SEO, social media marketing, content marketing, email campaigns, analytics, advertising platforms, and modern AI-powered marketing tools while working remotely.Your key responsibilities will include:Supporting the planning and execution of digital marketing campaignsConducting keyword, audience, competitor, and market researchAssisting with SEO strategies and website optimizationCreating and coordinating content for websites, blogs, and social media platformsManaging and scheduling social media content across relevant platformsSupporting email marketing campaigns and audience communicationsMonitoring website traffic, engagement, conversions, and other marketing metricsAnalyzing campaign performance and preparing marketing reportsAssisting with paid advertising campaigns and performance optimizationIdentifying trends and opportunities across digital marketing channelsSupporting content calendars and campaign planningCollaborating with designers and content creators to develop marketing assetsPerforming A/B testing and analyzing campaign resultsMonitoring competitor activities and industry developmentsMaintaining marketing databases, campaign records, and performance documentationSupporting lead-generation and customer acquisition initiativesUsing analytics tools to identify opportunities for improving marketing performanceWe believe in learning by doing. You'll gain hands-on experience with SEO, Google Analytics, social media platforms, email marketing, content management systems, advertising platforms, Excel, data visualization, and modern AI-powered marketing tools.This is a hands-on role where creativity, analytical thinking, communication, curiosity, and attention to detail are essential. You'll have opportunities to work on real-world marketing campaigns and contribute to strategies that support brand growth and customer acquisition.RequirementsBachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Mass Media, or a related field0-2 years of experience in digital marketing or a relevant internship/projectBasic understanding of digital marketing concepts and channelsFamiliarity with SEO, social media marketing, content marketing, and email marketingBasic understanding of website analytics and marketing metricsFamiliarity with Google Analytics, Search Console, or similar tools is a plusExperience with social media management platforms is beneficialBasic understanding of paid advertising platforms is a plusStrong written and verbal communication skillsGood content research and writing abilitiesStrong analytical and problem-solving skillsCreative mindset with an interest in digital trendsStrong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasksFamiliarity with Canva or similar design tools is a plusAbility to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environmentBenefitsCompetitive salaryFully remote work flexibilityPaid time off and holidaysProfessional development opportunitiesCompany-provided equipmentOpportunities to work with modern marketing, analytics, automation, and AI-powered tools Show more Show less

job.rawText: AI at ZapierAt Zapier, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.Job Posted: September 2026Location: IndiaHi there!We're looking for a Director, India to serve as the senior-most, India-based leader of Zapier's India entity, acting as both a statutory Board Director and General Manager. This is a pivotal role at a formative stage of our India presence: you'll ensure full legal, tax, and regulatory compliance for our India entity while also serving as the bridge between Zapier's global strategy and its execution on the ground.You'll report to Ryan Roccon, our Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer, and partner closely with our India-based managers, our Operating Committee, and our external advisors at Deloitte. You'll own India operations as the accountable local leader, drive delivery and performance across India-based functions, and represent the entity to auditors and regulators. If you're looking for a role where you can build governance rhythms and operating discipline from the ground up while being the trusted face of a company's India presence, this is it.Our Commitment to ApplicantsCulture and Values at ZapierZapier Guide to Remote WorkZapier Code of ConductDiversity and Inclusivity at ZapierAbout YouYou have 15-20+ years of experience, including 5+ years in India site leadership, GM, COO, or country-head-type roles for multinational companies.You have strong business acumen and the ability to manage stakeholders in a global, matrix organization, where functional teams report to global leaders while maintaining a dotted-line relationship to you.You have strong knowledge of and exposure to financial, legal entity, and statutory compliance, audit, tax, and transfer pricing, gained through demonstrated experience working with Big 4 firms and/or legal counsel on India entity matters.You have strong people leadership and hiring instincts, with experience across hiring, performance management, employee relations, and exits in an Indian context.You're comfortable taking on statutory director responsibilities and signing off on board and compliance documents, including the personal liability that comes with it.You build positive working relationships and trust quickly with India-based teams, delivery managers, and the global executive team, and develop a deep understanding of the business, strategy, operations, and priorities.You're an effective communicator who can drive results and hold your ground in a complex, matrixed environment while remaining people-focused.Nice to have: prior experience setting up or scaling a Global Capability Center in India.Things You'll DoServe as the primary liaison between Zapier's India operations and global leadership, ensuring alignment and coordination and escalating key issues to the executive team.Lead overall India operations, translating global strategy into local execution and providing regular updates to US leadership.Serve as the senior-most site leader for all India-based employees, establishing governance rhythms and driving a high-performance, high-autonomy, values-driven 100% remote team.Act as a statutory Board Director for Zapier India: attend board meetings, approve minutes and resolutions and sign statutory filings.Ensure full statutory, tax, and financial compliance of the Indian legal entity, and serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and Indian regulatory authorities.Partner with Deloitte and internal finance on tax filings, audits, transfer pricing, and other regulatory matters.Own all India people decisions: hiring, compensation, performance, and terminations, while functional managers continue to run day-to-day work for their teams.Partner with HR on people strategy, talent decisions, employee relations, and local policy implementation, and ensure compliance with Indian labor law, including POSH and state-specific requirements.Manage local vendor relationships for Zapier's India presence.Identify, monitor, and mitigate key risks to Zapier's India operations.How To ApplyAt Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here.Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.Application DeadlineThe anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working. Show more Show less

We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.Role Overview:We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Technical Lead to architect, design, and oversee development of high-performance backend systems and distributed applications. The ideal candidate is an expert in Python (FastAPI preferred) or Java, with strong experience in building scalable REST & GraphQL APIs, asynchronous systems, cloud deployments on AWS, and containerized microservices. performance, security, and maintainability.Build asynchronous task pipelines and microservices using Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis, or equivalent message brokers.Design efficient database schemas and queries (PostgreSQL/MySQL/NoSQL).Cloud & DevOpsDeploy, manage, and optimize systems on AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).Implement CI/CD processes, automated pipelines, and environment provisioning.Use containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes for microservice orchestration.Ensure observability through logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.Architecture & System DesignLead discussions on scalability, distributed architecture, caching, API design, and event-driven patterns.Drive decisions on best-fit technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native approaches.Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance standards.Required Skills & Qualifications10–13 years of backend engineering experience, with 3+ years in a technical leadership role.Strong experience with:a) Python (FastAPI preferred) OR Javab) REST & GraphQL API developmentc) Celery / async processingd) AWS cloud servicese) Docker, Kubernetes, and containerizationSolid knowledge of:a) Microservices architecturesb) Distributed systemsc) SQL and NoSQL databasesd) CI/CD pipelinese) Monitoring and alerting frameworksNice-to-HaveFrontend development experience using job.rawText: SPM/Project Lead, FundraisingPartnerships & Strategic InitiativesCentral Square FoundationLocation: New DelhiReporting to: Senior Project Lead, FundraisingExperience: 5-8 yearsAbout Central Square FoundationFounded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is an education-focused nonprofit working to ensure quality education for every child in India through system-led reform. CSF partners with the government to design, implement and scale evidence-based initiatives across its five priorities: Foundational Literacy and Numeracy, ensuring every child attains foundational literacy and numeracy skills; Early Childhood Education, building strong early learning foundations that prepare every child to succeed from their very first day of school; School Governance, strengthening school accountability and parent engagement for improving school quality; EdTech & AI, leveraging technology to improve teaching and learning at scale; and High Potential Students, creating pathways for high potential students from underserved backgrounds to realize their potential and become leaders of tomorrow. CSF works across 13 states and one Union Territory.About Partnerships & Strategic InitiativesThe Partnerships & Strategic Initiatives (PSI) team works across CSF to build and nurture strategic partnerships and initiatives that advance the organisation's mission. The Fundraising team, a core part of PSI, is responsible for mobilising the resources and building the partnerships that enable CSF to pursue its priorities. This includes developing a strong and diversified fundraising pipeline, building and deepening donor relationships, translating CSF's work into compelling funding propositions, supporting effective donor stewardship, and strengthening the systems and processes that enable high-quality and agile resource mobilisation. The team works closely with colleagues across CSF, including programme teams, leadership, Finance, Communications and RMEAL, as well as a wide range of donors, government stakeholders, philanthropic organisations and partners across the education and impact ecosystem.Position OverviewWe are looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to help build and grow CSF’s fundraising efforts, bringing strong relationship-building, strategic thinking and execution capabilities to the Fundraising team within PSI across both donor cultivation and relationship management.The Project Lead, Partnerships & Strategic Initiatives (Fundraising) will play a key role in advancing CSF’s fundraising efforts and building the institutional resources needed to support its mission.This is a broad, hands-on role spanning the full fundraising lifecycle, from prospect research and pipeline development through outreach, donor cultivation, proposal development, engagement, stewardship and renewals, across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations and HNIs/UHNIs.Reporting to the Senior Project Lead, PSI, the role combines independent ownership with close collaboration, working closely with the Senior Project Lead and relevant colleagues across the fundraising function.Key ResponsibilitiesFundraising Pipeline BuildingBuild and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective donors across CSR, domestic and global philanthropic foundations, HNIs/UHNIs and other funding sources.Conduct prospect research and landscape analysis to identify and qualify prospective funders, assessing their priorities, interests, funding potential, decision-making processes and potential areas of alignment with CSF.Identify relevant entry points for qualified prospects and develop tailored approaches for initiating and deepening conversations. Manage assigned opportunities through the fundraising funnel, from prospect identification and qualification through outreach, cultivation, proposal development and closure. Identify opportunities to leverage CSF's existing relationships and networks to strengthen connections with prospective funders and broaden the fundraising pipeline. Stay abreast of developments across philanthropy, CSR and the wider social-impact ecosystem to identify emerging funding opportunities.Donor CultivationDevelop and advance relationships with prospective funders, identifying relevant opportunities and approaches to build interest in CSF and progress potential funding relationships.Develop and execute thoughtful cultivation plans for priority prospects, identifying relevant opportunities and touchpoints to build familiarity, trust and interest in CSF’s work. job.rawText: Revenue Growth StrategistPositioningYou will own the pricing and revenue-growth architecture across five monetization models feeding off one audience — the hardest problem in this business isn't getting attention, it's not leaving money on the table once you have it.About Astro Arun PanditA 51+ year legacy astrology and spiritual-guidance business built around a founder with 2.4M+ Instagram and 2.75M+ YouTube followers, serving customers across 82+ countries. One audience is monetized through five structurally different models: paid consultations, one-time digital reports, tiered education via Occultgurukul.com, e-commerce via Gemsmantra.com, and occasion-triggered puja bookings — plus an emerging subscription layer in the Horocosmo app.The MandateIn your first three months, you will design and ship a unified pricing and revenue-growth architecture across all five revenue lines, delivering a measurable improvement in blended margin and customer lifetime value without cannibalizing any existing vertical. You own the roadmap — you don't just recommend it.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign and run a cross-vertical pricing framework across consultations, reports, courses, e-commerce, and rituals, using structured price experiments to find each vertical's revenue-maximizing point without eroding volume.Map the customer monetization journey (free tool → consultation → report → course → product → subscription) and define the sequencing and pricing logic that maximizes lifetime value while preventing tier cannibalization.Own unit economics and margin analysis per vertical, identifying which products subsidize acquisition versus drive profit, and adjust pricing and packaging accordingly.Design revenue model structures — subscription, transactional, or bundled — for new and existing offerings, starting with formalizing the Horocosmo app's subscription economics.Conduct willingness-to-pay and competitive research specific to spiritual-services, edtech, and D2C wellness markets to anchor pricing decisions in evidence rather than intuition.Partner with product, content, and consultation teams to instrument revenue tracking and build forecasting models leadership can rely on for planning.Build and maintain the revenue and pricing dashboards leadership uses to make weekly and quarterly decisions.Establish and lead a small pricing/revenue analytics function, hiring and directing analysts as the revenue-growth roadmap scales.Success MetricsBlended ARPU and LTV growth across the five verticals, tracked quarterly.Margin improvement by vertical against a documented baseline.Price-test win rate — the share of pricing experiments that beat the control on revenue or margin.Cross-sell/upsell attach rate along the defined customer journey.Forecast accuracy of revenue models against actuals.Revenue per active customer, tracked across the full monetization stack rather than any single vertical.Milestones — 3 / 6 / 12 Months3 months: Complete a full audit of pricing and unit economics across all five verticals; present a prioritized revenue-growth roadmap.6 months: Ship and measure the first two cross-vertical price or packaging experiments, with a documented lift in margin or attach rate.12 months: Hit blended LTV and margin targets; embed a repeatable pricing-experimentation system; run a pricing/analytics function that operates without your day-to-day involvement in the mechanics.Required Experience & CapabilitiesMust-have6–10 years in revenue growth, pricing, or monetization roles, with direct ownership of a P&L or pricing model.Demonstrated experience moving between subscription, transactional, course/cohort, and e-commerce economics.Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills — able to build and defend a pricing model from first principles.Proven ability to influence founders and executives without formal authority over them.Strong plusExperience in creator-economy, edtech, D2C, or subscription-app businesses.Experience in a founder-led or personal-brand-driven company.Exposure to India plus cross-border commerce, given the business's reach across 195+/82+ countries.Competencies & TraitsStructured problem-solving under ambiguity — builds a pricing framework where no clean precedent exists.Commercial storytelling to non-technical founders — turns modeling into decisions leadership will actually act on.Bias to experimentation with statistical rigor — tests before scaling, and knows a real result from noise.Systems thinking across a multi-vertical business — sees how a pricing change in one vertical moves the others.Ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations — treats the revenue number as personally accountable.Compensation PhilosophyCompensation includes a fixed base plus a variable/incentive component tied directly to the success metrics above — you are paid for the outcomes you own, not just the work you do. A specific band will be shared during the interview process based on experience and scope.Location, Reporting Line & Working StyleReports directly to the founder/CXO. Based out of the company's Noida office, with flexibility for a hybrid rhythm where the work allows it. In keeping with how the company operates, you'll have real latitude in how you organize your work — the mandate above is the only fixed constraint.Interested candidate share your updated CV at recruitment@astroarunpandit.org Show more Show less

job.rawText: Company Description Ichelon Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd. is a healthcare and life sciences focused consulting firm specializing in business consulting, market research, and digital marketing. The company partners with over 150 healthcare organizations worldwide, supporting their business and system scale-up objectives. With more than 30 proprietary tools for diagnosis, cost optimization, and growth modeling, Ichelon is a preferred consulting, audit, and implementation partner for healthcare growth initiatives. Its pharmacovigilance arm delivers substantial medical and scientific content each month for leading organizations across the APAC region. The healthcare and life sciences verticals are supported by strong domain expertise and data-driven methodologies.Role Description The Executive – Performance Marketing role is a full-time, on-site position based in Gurugram. The role involves planning, executing, and optimizing performance marketing campaigns across digital channels to support healthcare and life sciences clients. Daily activities include developing campaign strategies, conducting market and audience research, managing paid media (such as search and social ads), tracking campaign performance, and preparing reports and insights for stakeholders. The executive will collaborate with sales, marketing, and consulting teams to align campaigns with business objectives, improve lead generation, and enhance brand visibility. The role also includes monitoring industry trends, testing new performance marketing tactics, and ensuring data-driven decision-making for continuous improvement.Qualifications Strong market planning and marketing skills, with the ability to design and manage performance-focused campaigns.Proficiency in market research and audience analysis to inform campaign strategy and targeting.Excellent communication skills for collaborating with internal teams and presenting performance insights.Sales and marketing acumen to support lead generation and conversion goals.Experience with digital advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads) and campaign optimization tools.Analytical mindset with competence in using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, dashboards) to interpret data and drive decisions.Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant certifications in digital/performance marketing are an advantage.Ability to work on-site in Gurugram, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Prior experience in healthcare, life sciences, or consulting domains is preferred but not mandatory. job.rawText: Job Description: Digital Marketing Executive Company: EventIron Location: India Type: Full-Time Experience: 6 Months – 2 Years About EventIron EventIron is a growing MarTech and SalesTech services company that helps businesses get more value from their technology stack through the right mix of people, process, technology, and data. We work across areas such as marketing automation, CRM, event tech, integrations, and digital operations. Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to join our team. This role is ideal for a professional with 6 months to 2 years of experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content, or brand building, who is ready to independently own and execute marketing activities rather than just assist with them. The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for executing and managing digital marketing activities across LinkedIn, social media, website, SEO, content, email marketing, and digital campaigns. The role will involve planning and executing campaigns, tracking performance, analyzing digital marketing metrics, and identifying opportunities to improve brand visibility, engagement, and lead generation. The Digital Marketing Executive will work closely with internal teams to drive EventIron’s marketing initiatives across social media, website, blogs, and email marketing — taking ownership of planning, execution, and performance reporting in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Social Media Management Own and grow EventIron’s social media presence, especially on LinkedIn and build strategy to increase brand visibility, engagement, and lead generation. Create and execute social media campaigns aligned with business and marketing objectives. Coordinate with internal team members to gather content ideas, updates, achievements, and campaign inputs Plan and execute social media content, captions, campaigns, and content calendars. Schedule, publish, and manage the day-to-day social media posting cadence Track and analyze social media performance metrics such as reach, engagement, clicks, and conversions, and optimize content accordingly. Content & Blog Management Work with internal subject matter experts to gather inputs for blogs, articles, and thought leadership content Research, draft, edit, and optimize blogs and articles for the website with minimal supervision. Own the content publishing calendar and ensure timely delivery Repurpose and distribute content across social media, email campaigns, and website channels to maximize reach and engagement. Apply basic SEO practices, including keyword usage, headings, meta descriptions, and internal linking, to improve content visibility. Website Management Manage, update, and optimize website content including blogs, service pages, announcements, and other marketing content. Coordinate with internal stakeholders or external web support as needed Review website pages for content accuracy, SEO, user experience, formatting, and consistency. Monitor website performance and recommend improvements to increase traffic, engagement, and lead generation. Use Google Analytics/GA4 and Google Search Console to monitor website traffic, search performance, and user engagement. Email Marketing Plan, draft, and execute email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and promotional content. Own email campaign execution end-to-end in coordination with the internal team Manage audience segmentation, email personalization, content formatting, scheduling, and campaign tracking. Monitor and analyze email performance metrics such as open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and engagement, and optimize campaigns accordingly. Support lead-generation and lead-nurturing campaigns through email marketing. Team Coordination & Execution Work closely with leadership and internal teams to gather information, align timelines, and drive tasks to closure Follow up with relevant team members to ensure marketing deliverables move on time Maintain and update the marketing activity tracker and content calendar independently Support other branding, campaign, and communication tasks as needed Skills & Qualifications 6 months to 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, preferably B2B or MarTech/SaaS MBA or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field preferred Strong written and verbal communication skills Solid working knowledge of social media platforms and digital marketing practices Demonstrated experience in content writing, branding, or B2B marketing Organized, detail-oriented, and able to coordinate with multiple stakeholders independently Comfortable working in a collaborative team environment Working knowledge of website content management systems, email marketing tools, Canva, or social media scheduling tools Familiarity with LinkedIn marketing, blog publishing, or SEO basics is a strong plus What We’re Looking For A self-starter who takes ownership and needs minimal hand-holding Someone who can independently convert ideas and inputs into structured marketing output A person who can work with internal teams patiently and effectively to get tasks completed Someone with creativity, consistency, and strong follow-through What You Will Gain Ownership of end-to-end B2B marketing execution and brand building Direct exposure to leadership and cross-functional teams Growing hands-on experience in content marketing, social media, email marketing, and website management The opportunity to grow into a senior marketing role within a growing MarTech business Show more Show less

job.rawText: You'll own voice AI at JoyzAI. All of it. The real-time pipeline (audio in, speech understood, LLM reasoning, tools called, speech out), the telephony that gets the call connected, the platform a client uses to configure and run their agent, and the webhooks and CRM plumbing that turn a call into a lead. It's a working product with real clients on it today. Your job is to take it from working to something we'd bet the company on, and to build the team that keeps it that way.This is a head-of role at a company of under 15 people, which makes it a player-coach job. You set the technical direction for voice: what we build on, what we buy, what we rip out. And you write a lot of the code yourself. When a call stutters, drops, or talks over the customer, you're the one who finds out why, fixes it at the root, and changes the system so it can't happen again. When a client wants an agent that does something we've never done, you decide whether the platform can, and then you make it so.What you'll doOwn the voice stackSet the architecture and roadmap for the real-time calling pipeline: telephony ↔ audio streaming ↔ speech/real-time models ↔ tool calls ↔ speech out, with latency you can't feel.Own the hard voice problems, with opinions earned in production: turn-taking and barge-in, silence and voicemail detection, noise and echo, language switching mid-call (English ↔ Hinglish ↔ regional), and graceful recovery when a model or carrier hiccups.Make the build-vs-buy calls across STT/TTS, real-time LLMs, VAD, and telephony carriers. Run the evaluations, own the vendor relationships, decide what we build on next, and know when it's time to switch.Design non-blocking tool calling inside live calls (lookups, bookings, CRM writes) so the agent never goes silent or loses the thread.Define what "good" means for a voice agent: the quality bar, the evaluation framework, the test harness. We should know a change made agents better before a client tells us.Build the platform around the callsOwn the Node.js/Express services and APIs that have to hold up as call volume grows: call orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, recording and transcript storage.Own the product around the calls: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), call logs and transcripts, analytics, and bulk-calling campaign controls.Wire calls into the rest of the platform: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp follow-ups after a call, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead-form ingestion.Keep the Angular frontends our team and clients use (the agent configurator, the inbox, the call review screens) clean and usable, whether you're writing them or reviewing them.Reliability, cost & scaleInstrument everything: time-to-first-word, per-call latency breakdowns, drop rates, tool-call failures, model cost per minute. Own the dashboards that tell us something's wrong before a client does.Treat cost per minute as a number you're accountable for. Bring it down without hurting quality: model choice, streaming strategy, caching, carrier routing.Own production. Debug incidents on real client calls, reproduce them, fix them at the root, and build the incident and on-call practice so the next one gets caught faster.Lead the teamBuild and lead the voice engineering team. Hire, set the bar, review the code, and make the engineers around you better.Own the engineering standard for voice: architecture decisions, code quality, documentation, what ships and what doesn't.Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents to behave well: new tool types, better fallbacks, a proper test harness for prompts.Be the technical authority in front of clients on the hard deployments, the ones where the answer isn't in the docs yet.Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next voice agent takes hours to stand up, not days.Roughly 60% of your time is hands-on: architecting, coding, debugging live calls, shipping. The other 40% is leading: the team, the roadmap, model and vendor decisions, and the client conversations where the platform's direction gets decided. That ratio shifts toward leading as the team grows, but you never stop being able to open the code and fix it yourself.What we're looking forThree things are non-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet all three. They're the first thing we screen for.You have successfully deployed voice AI agents to production, and owned them there. Not a demo, not a hackathon, not a pilot that quietly ended. A system where real customers spoke to an AI over a phone line or live audio stream, at real volume, for months, and it stayed in production because it worked. You owned the pipeline end to end: streaming audio, speech and real-time models, latency, interruptions, the failures at 2am, the cost. In our first conversation we'll ask what you shipped, how many calls it handled, what broke, and what you did about it. Come with specifics. Experience at a Voice AI company is a strong signal.You can build the whole thing yourself. Backend services, APIs, real-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You've done this as an individual contributor and you can still do it. A head of voice who can't debug the socket is not who we're hiring.You've set the technical direction for a voice product before. As a founding engineer, tech lead, architect, or head of engineering. The title matters less than the fact that people looked to you for what to build and how, and you were right often enough that the product worked.Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:Work fluently across the MEAN stack — MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js — with TypeScript throughout.Design and debug real-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming audio, event-driven architectures, queues.Integrate with telephony/SIP providers and messaging APIs (WhatsApp Business API) and handle their quirks in production.Work with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, and speech models, and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes, not just accuracy.Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role-based access.Hire well, review well, and explain a hard technical call to a founder or a client in plain language.Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.Nice to have: deep experience with real-time voice frameworks or APIs (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar); Indian telephony providers; Hinglish or Indic speech models; GCP/AWS at scale; having scaled a voice product from its first client to serious call volume; having built a voice team from scratch.Full-time, on-site in Noida.Why JoyzAI?✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — voice AI is yours. Make the decisions, set the direction, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.✨ Top-of-the-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.✨ 5-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.✨ High-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that. job.rawText: About the Role We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Vice President – Travel Business to lead and drive the growth of our travel business. The ideal candidate will have 15+ years of strong experience in the travel and tourism industry, with proven expertise in DMC operations, B2B sales, business development, operations management, and large-team leadership. Key Responsibilities Lead the overall travel business strategy, revenue growth, and profitability. Develop and execute business plans to achieve aggressive revenue and growth targets. Drive B2B sales and business development across travel agencies, tour operators, corporate clients, and other travel partners. Build, manage, and strengthen relationships with key B2B partners, agents, suppliers, and strategic accounts. Lead and expand DMC business operations, ensuring strong destination-level execution and partner management. Develop new markets, destinations, products, and revenue streams. Identify new business opportunities and establish strategic partnerships with domestic and international travel partners. Oversee end-to-end travel operations including product contracting, itinerary planning, reservations, vendor coordination, service delivery, and customer experience. Ensure operational efficiency, service quality, cost optimization, and profitability. Lead, mentor, and develop large cross-functional teams across sales, operations, contracting, product, and customer service. Establish sales KPIs, operational KPIs, performance metrics, and accountability frameworks for teams. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, destination developments, and changing customer requirements. Work closely with senior management to formulate pricing, product, sales, and expansion strategies. Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts with suppliers, hotels, DMCs, airlines, and other strategic partners. Ensure strong coordination between Sales, Operations, Product, Finance, and Customer Experience functions. Mandatory Requirements 15+ years of experience in the Travel & Tourism industry. Mandatory: Proven DMC (Destination Management Company) experience. Strong experience in B2B travel sales and business development. Proven experience in travel operations management. Experience managing and leading large teams/functions. Strong network among travel agents, tour operators, corporate travel partners, and industry stakeholders. Strong understanding of both sales and operational functions within the travel industry. Ability to work at a strategic level while maintaining strong execution capabilities. Preferred Profile Candidates with experience in: DMC / Destination Management Inbound & outbound tourism B2B travel business Corporate travel MICE Group tours & FIT International destinations Travel technology / OTA ecosystem Large-scale travel operations will be preferred. Key Competencies Strategic Leadership | DMC Management | B2B Sales | Business Development | Revenue Growth | Travel Operations | Team Leadership | P&L Management | Vendor Management | Contracting & Negotiation | Partner Management | Market Expansion | Customer Experience Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month Work Location: In person
