job.rawText: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company with workplace recognition in multiple categories! Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated Team Members who share a drive to succeed as professionals and together as a company. A great product, amazing people and our stable financial history have made us one of the largest used car finance companies in the United States. In this role, you will work as a dedicated member of a globally distributed team, partnering closely with business partners in the U.S. to design, build, and scale solutions that directly impact our customers and operations. While your legal employer will be our EoR partner, you will be fully integrated into our Credit Acceptance team for day-to-day work and collaboration. As a Staff Business Analyst with a Data Engineering focus, you operate with a strategic, solution-driven mindset, aligning enterprise data initiatives to business objectives and long-term data strategy. You serve as a subject matter expert across multiple domains, connecting business processes, data requirements, and technical implementation at an enterprise scale. You lead the definition of data standards, including traceability, lineage, and quality, ensuring data assets are scalable, governed, and usable across the organization. You drive advanced analytics and insight generation that informs executive decision-making, while championing a culture where all data initiatives are measured against business value realization. You partner with Product, PMO, and Engineering to ensure sustainable data quality, enable self-service analytics, and deliver data solutions that support evolving enterprise goals. This position will work remotely from India. Outcomes and Activities: Drives Data Strategy, Governance, and Standards Leads with a strategic, solution-driven mindset, ensuring data initiatives align to enterprise goals and long-term data strategy. Defines and drives enterprise standards for traceability, lineage, data mapping, and data quality, embedding them into scalable and sustainable architectures. Leads the design and adoption of governance frameworks that ensure data usability, compliance, and long-term value across the organization. Connects Business Needs to Technical Execution Partners with PMO, Product, stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable, future-proof data solutions. Demonstrates deep expertise across domains by connecting business processes, data requirements, and system design to drive cross-functional strategy. Ensures business logic is accurately implemented in technical solutions and aligned across end-to-end data ecosystems. Leads Strategic Data Analysis and Insight Generation Leads complex, cross-domain data analysis initiatives to uncover insights, validate data integrity, and support decision-making. Sets the standard for business insight generation through advanced analytics that influence executive decisions. Applies strong understanding of application data and design to recommend efficient, practical, and value-driven solutions. Manages Delivery, Risk, and Execution Quality Maintains and refines application backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and alignment to business objectives. Identifies and manages risks related to scope, timeline, budget, and business impact, recommending mitigation strategies. Ensures application performance, reliability, and stability by partnering closely with engineering teams. Applies and improves standards for coding, documentation, testing, and delivery processes. Establishes Data Quality, Process Improvement, and Operational Excellence Identifies data and process gaps across systems and domains, driving cross-functional resolution and continuous improvement. Leads initiatives to enhance data quality, system performance, and operational scalability. Decreases incidents, improves system uptime, and strengthens overall data reliability. Continuously evaluates and improves team processes, tools, and system effectiveness. Enables Business Adoption and Value Realization Aligns data solutions to business workflows, enabling self-service analytics and improving accessibility of insights. Ensures data deliverables are tied to measurable business value and outcomes. Champions a culture of data-driven decision-making and user adoption across the organization. Operates as a Staff-Level Leader and Trusted Advisor Independently leads work in complex, ambiguous, cross-functional environments with minimal direction. Serves as a go-to expert and trusted advisor across multiple domains. Mentors team members, supports team health, and identifies coaching opportunities to elevate performance. Communicates effectively across technical and business audiences, ensuring alignment and clarity Supports Advanced Data Capabilities and Future Innovation Demonstrates working knowledge of AI/ML approaches and partners with data science and engineering teams to align models with business objectives. Contributes to forward-looking data capabilities that enhance enterprise insights and strategic decision-making. Maintains Accountability and Compliance Remains compliant with company policies, processes, and legal/regulatory requirements.Performs all other duties as assigned and meets departmental expectations for attendance and participation. Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role. Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience. Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions. One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively. Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Minimum of 5+ years; experience in Business Analyst or related role Excellent oral and written communications skills Experience mentoring less senior team members in a Business Analysts role. Proven experience in designing and implementing technology enabled solutions. Experience in helping develop and maintain processes that define best practices for gathering requirements, designing and prototyping, User Acceptance Testing, and implementing multiple medium to large scale projects. Business Process Reengineering experience in Finance Industry Experience leading 2+ end-to-end project implementations as a BA Basic knowledge of web technology You will maintain a deep and comprehensive understanding of the system. Remain compliant with our policies, processes and legal guidelinesWork onsite at the assigned Credit Acceptance location Preferred: Experience with System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Project management experience, PMP Certification Minimum of 5-year experience supporting a web application as a business/quality/functional analyst Ability to write complex database queries (SQL / PLSQL) and study data patterns Basic understanding of Java technologies Respond promptly and effectively to problems, projects, and tasks Be organized, with ability to multi-task and prioritize multiple requests Convey complex information in a timely and easily understood way to all levels of the organization Demonstrate insight; make recommendations as opportunities arise Be self-driven, motivated to help, and able to perform with moderate supervision Maintain customer focus; keep the customer’s and company’s best interest in mind Work well with abstract concepts. Be analytical. Solve problems CTC Range: ₹ 27,71,295 - ₹ 40,64,566 Total Compensation (CTC): Final CTC will be shared during the offer stage and will include all compensation components in detail as per EoR vendor's structure. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. INDENGLP #LI-Remote This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EoR) partner in India. You will be legally employed in India through our EoR partner While your legal employer is the EoR partner, you will work full-time and be fully aligned to Credit Acceptance Your day-to-day work, responsibilities, and performance expectations will be consistent with our global team members You will receive locally compliant payroll, benefits, and statutory coverage through the EoR partner Our Company Values: To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions. Respectful by collaborating and actively listening. Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions. Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage. Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting. Expectations: Regularly overlap with U.S. business hours to support collaboration with global team members. Remain compliant with our policies, processes and guidelines All other duties as assigned Attendance as required by department

job.rawText: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.Job CategorySalesJob DetailsAbout SalesforceSalesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.Every CIO today is being forced to evaluate their integration strategy in order to move faster and increase innovation to meet the demands of the market. Organisations are spending over $443 billion on integration work every year, yet they still can’t move fast enough to outpace competition. MuleSoft is building a new category of software to uniquely solve this massive challenge, with our industry-leading integration platform and a profound focus on customer success for over 1,200 enterprises across the globe.We are looking for outcomes-oriented, highly collaborative Account Executives with an ambitious spirit to help us take on this massive market opportunity and achieve significant revenue targets. MuleSoft is one of the fastest growing enterprise software companies ever, and our Sales team is key to our explosive growth across the globe.This is not your standard tactical role selling a piece of software. You will be a key member of a close-knit, cross-functional team that is responsible for owning and driving the go-to-market strategy for your territory, and leading the sales cycle. We are paving the way to not only change the way our customers build software, but transform the way they do business. You will sell strategic business outcomes with long-term, high growth engagements.In this role, you will be challenged as a salesperson to grow personally and professionally: The majority of leaders in our Field organisation come through internal promotions, and you’ll be surrounded by some of the most thoughtful people in the world who will push you and support you to do the best work of your career.In Your First Year, You Can Expect To Work toward exceeding your ramped annual sales quota and create a pipeline that will propel the growth of your business in the following year Partner with our global Sales Enablement team, who will guide you through onboarding and development programs that ensure your success Create a plan for your own territory long-term, building demand and working on existing and newly created opportunities Become an expert in Data Foundation messaging, our sales approach, and our products and services Be surrounded by a team of fiercely motivated individuals who are committed to delivering extraordinary customer outcomesWhat You’ll Need To Be Successful Minimum 8+ Yrs relevant to middleware/integration/technology sales experience. Cumulative experiences that demonstrate your success in leading complex and commercially significant sales to IT and business leaders Experience driving large complex deals, $500K+ Strong domain expertise in the Named accounts (Including manufacturing industrues ) in West-India. At least 10+ years of experience in Solution sales within the Software industry Strong focus on delivering customer success with a consultative, outcome-based sales approach Value speaking directly and honestly with others’ best interests at heart (we use radical candor) A highly collaborative standout colleague with company-first mentality—“be a good human” is a core value, meaning we leave our egos at the door and support each other to get results and win together.About MuleSoft, a Salesforce CompanyOur mission is to help organizations change and innovate faster by making it easy to connect the world’s applications, data, and devices. Companies like Spotify, McDonald’s, and Unilever rely on MuleSoft to stay agile, deliver faster, and make the most of their IT investment with API-led connectivity. Hiring exceptional people who want to build a great company together is our number one priority, and we’re committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace where everyone is supported and inspired to do their best work. We work tirelessly to build this culture, and we’re proud to have been named the #1 Top Workplace in the Bay Area and a best place to work 6 years in a row.Unleash Your PotentialWhen you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.AccommodationsIf you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.Posting StatementSalesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. Show more Show less

job.rawText: Job Title: Head of AI Job Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Onsite) Overview The AI Specialist will lead the design, development, and implementation of Artificial Intelligence solutions that enhance teaching, learning, research, and administrative operations across the institution. This role combines technical expertise with an understanding of academic workflows to drive digital transformation, improve student outcomes, and increase operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will work with academic teams, IT, researchers, and leadership stakeholders to identify AI opportunities, build prototypes, deploy production-ready systems, and promote responsible AI adoption aligned with institutional policies. Key Responsibilities AI Strategy & Innovation Contribute to the development of the GEDU’s AI roadmap aligned with academic and operational goals. Identify high-impact AI use cases for student success, admissions, academic support, research enablement, and automation. Evaluate emerging technologies and propose scalable solutions. Solution Design & Development Build, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for use cases such as automated student support, predictive analytics, content generation, and academic analytics. Design and maintain AI pipelines, including data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and monitoring. Integrate AI solutions with existing systems (LMS/Moodle, SIS/Thesis, CRM/Zoho, ERP, HR systems, and data warehouse). Data Management & Engineering Work closely with Data & Analytics teams to ensure availability of clean, structured, and secure datasets. Collaborate on data governance, privacy, ethical AI, and compliance with regulations (GDPR, FERPA-equivalent guidelines). Implement feature engineering, model versioning, and MLOps best practices. AI for Teaching & Learning Support academic staff in using AI tools for course design, assessment, personalised learning pathways, and content creation. Provide training materials, workshops, and best-practice guidelines to academic and professional services teams. Collaborate on AI-enhanced learning analytics models to improve student retention and performance. Operational AI & Automation Develop AI-driven automations to streamline admissions, marketing, student support, and internal operations. Build chatbots, knowledge assistants, and process automations using LLMs, RPA, or workflow engines. Support AI adoption across departments through prototypes and proof-of-concept projects. Governance & Ethical AI Ensure responsible and transparent AI practices across the institution. Contribute to AI usage policies, risk assessments, and security frameworks. Promote fairness, bias detection, and responsible data handling. Required Experience & Qualifications Technical Skills Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI (LLMs). Hands-on experience with Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, LangChain, Azure OpenAI/ OpenAI APIs, or similar. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud (Azure preferred in HE). Experience deploying AI models in production using MLOps frameworks. Candidates must possess a minimum of ten years of work experience. Knowledge of data pipelines, ETL, SQL, data warehousing, and API integrations. Higher Education Experience (preferred) Familiarity with academic processes: admissions, student lifecycle, assessments, LMS, timetabling, student retention, and research workflows. Soft Skills Strong communication and stakeholder engagement abilities. Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborative mindset, capable of working with IT, academics, and leadership. Problem-solving and innovation-focused approach. Desirable Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Engineering, or related discipline. Certifications in cloud AI, data engineering, or machine learning (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialist, etc.) desirable. Experience in higher education or research environment is an advantage. KPIs & Success Measures Delivery of AI projects improving student experience and retention. Reduction in manual processes through AI automations. Adoption of AI best practices across academic and administrative functions. Measurable improvements in operational efficiency and decision-making. Increased AI literacy among staff through training initiatives. What GEDU Offers The opportunity to shape and lead a global data transformation in one of the world’s most dynamic education groups. A collaborative and mission-driven culture that values innovation, impact, and integrity. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Global project exposure and professional development opportunities.

job.rawText: About The TeamThe APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.About The RoleWe are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence across India. Reporting to the Managing Director, India, this leader will work hand in hand with the MD to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.This role is based in Bangalore, India and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.In This Role, You WillDefine and implement the India operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.Drive execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.Partner with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.Build and optimize scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.Identify operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.Support market entry strategies and operational readiness for IndiaEnable strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.Help build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.Collaborate closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.Ensure seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.Act as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across India.Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing regional operations team.Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.Develop leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.You Might Thrive In This Role If You HaveSignificant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within India.A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks.Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes.Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams.Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments.High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics.About OpenAIOpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy PolicyAt OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. Show more Show less

job.rawText: WhatWhereFind JobsMigration Modernization Architect, Professional ServicesSourceoGurugram, HaryanaApply on company sitesave-icon Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typematching preferenceFull-time LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR. As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools. On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications. AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies. Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs. Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. Key job responsibilities We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with: Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework. Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end. Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR) Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems. Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc. Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance. Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement. Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring Additional Desired Skills: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) Scripting (Python, PowerShell) CI/CD pipelines Programming Skill with Java, .Net Container technologies Database migrations Knowledge of compliance frameworks Multi-cloud experience About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Basic Qualifications Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3) Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience in software development 3+ years of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) experience Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of IT implementation experience Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience Experience with fully automated machine training (automatic re-training, automatic testing) Master's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD or equivalent research experience and 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. campaign objectives.Built a cohesive team and mentored them to excel.In 12 Months, You Would Have:Independently led and delivered on cross-client KPIs, becoming a standard-bearer for the company's skills.Exhibit strong business acumen for resource allocation and effective proposition selling to clients, with revenue responsibility.Understand 360-degree mediums (offline & online) and their impact on client businesses, including media buying, planning, brand investments, and tool utilization.Exhibit maturity and level headedness required to manage an existing team and clients effectively.Prioritize client and people management and servicing.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. Job title Education Counsellor Location Delhi/Gurugram Workplace type Hybrid Employment type Independent Contractor Job description Education Counsellor Guiding prospective learners through educational fit discovery, qualification, and structured follow-up, this role establishes clear pathways toward enrollment. About the opportunity As an Education Counsellor, you will manage assigned learner cases, helping individuals evaluate educational offerings against their professional goals and constraints. Operating with high follow-up discipline, you will serve as a primary point of contact, ensuring that every interaction is documented accurately and that sensitive policy or commercial questions are escalated appropriately. Your daily focus centers on maintaining clear, structured communication channels and documenting learner qualification status. By providing objective guidance without making unsupported promises, you help learners make informed decisions while ensuring seamless handoffs to academic or administrative teams upon enrollment. What you will work on Evaluate assigned learner profiles and inquiries to determine program fit and eligibility based on established admission criteria. Maintain detailed, up-to-date case notes documenting learner needs, constraints, and follow-up timelines within the approved workspace. Guide prospective learners through the enrollment process, explaining program structures, requirements, and next steps clearly. Identify and escalate complex commercial, policy, or technical queries to specialized internal teams rather than resolving them without authorization. Provide post-enrollment continuity support for designated learner cohorts to assist with early-stage onboarding and transition challenges. What you will deliver Completed learner qualification logs detailing eligibility status, professional constraints, and program fit for all assigned leads. Counselling summary notes archived in the case workspace outlining specific learner objectives and recommended educational pathways. Structured continuity handoff documents containing historical interaction notes and next-step instructions for successfully enrolled learners. A case follow-up state log documenting contact attempts, response rates, and pending action items for the assigned pipeline. What we are looking for Minimum qualification: Diploma. Experience in admissions, counselling, learner success, customer support, or education operations. Clear communication and careful follow-up without broad access to unrelated learner data. Ability to maintain notes, qualification status, and next steps accurately. Judgment to escalate sensitive, commercial, or policy questions instead of guessing. Core skills Counselling Follow-up discipline Learner qualification Case notes Tools and platforms Role Profile tools are approved, non-exclusive familiarity signals. Exact tools depend on the approved scope and can be learned where appropriate. Assigned case workspace Approved communication channels Working arrangement Contract or consulting scope, compensation, confidentiality, and operating expectations are confirmed in writing before work begins. Independent Contractor Remote Delhi/Gurugram Full-time Compensation: Starting at ₹1,20,000 per annum Selection process Our Talent team reviews the application for relevant evidence, availability, communication, and fit with the current scope. Shortlisted applicants may complete a focused conversation or practical task before a final decision. Important expectations Communicate clearly, collaborate respectfully, protect confidential information, use AI responsibly, and follow the applicable company policies, agreed scope, and access requirements. This opportunity does About RSAI Academy RSAI Academy is the practical AI learning brand of Rhythmic Souls Private Limited. We help learners and working professionals build useful AI skills through live instruction, guided practice, mentorship, and real-world projects. Our programmes focus on clarity, responsible AI use, measurable outcomes, and skills that can be applied in real work. How to apply Apply through the RSAI Academy website using the application link in this posting. This helps us review every application in the correct role context. We do not accept applications through platform-native forms, email, or direct messages. Application information is used only to evaluate and manage the relevant RSAI Academy opportunity, subject to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Pay: From ₹10,000.00 per month Benefits: Flexible schedule Application Question(s): Only the Applications made via the link in the JD are reviewed. So, please apply through that link at the top of the job description Education: Diploma (Required) Language: English (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurugram, Haryana (Gurugram)

job.rawText: Join our Team About this opportunity The Solution Architect – FinTech is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering end-to-end technical and business solutions across digital payments, mobile money, lending, KYC, digital identity, merchant solutions, and financial services platforms. This role requires strong financial domain knowledge, deep technical expertise, and the ability to work consultatively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets. Key Responsibilities FinTech Solution Design & Architecture Design scalable, secure, and regulatory-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations. Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions. Translate business requirements into detailed technical designs spanning cloud, APIs, microservices, protocols, and core financial systems. Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.). Customer Engagement & Consultative Advisory Engage with banks, fintech operators, mobile money providers, and partners to understand business goals and technical landscapes. Lead workshops, requirement sessions, and technical deep-dives to define use cases and solution scope. Prepare and deliver technical proposals, architecture documents, and customer presentations. Support commercial teams with solution positioning, negotiation, and value articulation.Project Delivery & Implementation Support Support implementation teams during development, integration, testing, and rollout of FinTech platforms. Provide architectural governance and ensure alignment with solution blueprint throughout delivery. Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling. Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features. Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities. Technical Skills Architecture design (cloud/on-prem), microservices, containerization, high-availability and DR setups. Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high-volume financial transactions. Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing. Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks. Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows. Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization). Business & Leadership Skills Strong consultative and customer-facing capabilities. Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact. Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi-functional units. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and negotiation skills. “All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.” Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. Dealing day to day basis with a big chain of hospitals Group or Direct B2C Consumer Market in Healthcare domain of Public health, Preventive Health, Early Detection, Dr Consultations, R&D Collaborations, Treatments, Surgeries, Disease Management related in Chronic Diseases such as in Oncology, Diabetes, Heart Disease, COPD & Mental Health, working directly dealing in the end to end Patient Management, Patient Case Management( Domestic and or International Patients), Medical Business Operation outside and inside a Hospital environment in Oncology/Diabetes/Heart/Chronic Diseases areas ( Digital Health Products & Solutions) while working with early-stage / established Health Startup. The Job Role, designation & compensation Package depending upon your domain expertise, business execution expertise /capability as an entrepreneur mindset, single-handed multi hat role and as a Team Leader to work under limited resources, and what you bring on the table with meeting deadlines, business target and commitment. ii) Mandatory to be an entrepreneur & should have worked/working in a HealthTech / Healthcare organisation of repute in an early-stage/ Growth stage Digital Health / Health Startup / Indian big company / fast-growing MNC in HealthTech / Healthcare. 2) Qualification: Atleast MBBS/BDS /BAMS or B.Sc( Nursing) / B.Sc/MSc/B.Pharma / from reputed Institutes with Science & Medical / BioScience Background. 3) Experience: At least 3 -15 Years of hardcore working experience directly dealing in the end to end Patient Management, Patient Case Management( Domestic and or International Patients), Medical Business Operation outside and inside a Hospital environment on a day-to-day basis in Oncology/Diabetes/Heart/Chronic Diseases areas ( Digital Health Products & Solutions) while working with early-stage / established Health Startup / Indian Healthcare Organisation.

job.rawText: Company Name- Khushnuma Sales Designation- Digital Marketing Executive Location- Gurugram (Sector 48) Profile Summary We are seeking a skilled performance-driven Digital Marketing Executive with hands-on experience in paid advertising, SEO, and social media management. This role requires a strategic thinker with execution capability and strong analytical skills to drive brand visibility and lead generation. Key Roles and Responsibilities ● Strategize, execute, and scale high-performing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns tailored for lead generation and brand growth. ● Oversee end-to-end social media management—curate, schedule, and optimize content that builds brand authority and drives audience engagement. ● Lead SEO efforts—conduct keyword research, optimize website content, and implement linkbuilding strategies to boost organic visibility. ● Drive qualified traffic through organic and paid funnels, leveraging innovative growth hacks and audience insights. ● Implement A/B testing for creatives, copy, targeting, and landing pages to constantly improve ROI and user experience. ● Monitor and analyze performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Tag Manager, etc, transforming data into actionable insights. ● Collaborate cross-functionally with content creators, designers, and developers to craft highconverting campaigns. ● Stay ahead of the curve with the latest trends, platform updates, and digital innovations to ensure a competitive edge. Prepare crisp performance dashboards, reports, and strategic inputs for management reviews. Knowledge Skills ● Education: Graduate or any related field ● Experience: Proven experience in meta ads and google ads campaign. ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ● Proficiency in Google Ads, Facebook Ads, SEO tools, and Google Analytics. ● Good understanding of online marketing channels and strategies. ● Basic content creation skills (e.g., Canva, copywriting). Attitude Others / Perks ● Adaptive to a challenging environment ● Proactive, results-oriented and organized ● Willingness to collaborate and coordinate with different and team members ● Young and vibrant team ● Fast paced and growth minded culture ● Networking opportunity ● Professional growth and recognition Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

job.rawText: About GravitonGraviton is a privately funded quantitative trading firm on a mission to redefine excellence in financial markets research. We operate across a wide range of asset classes and global trading venues, powered by advanced quantitative models and deep data-driven insights. From time series analysis and stochastic modeling to pattern recognition and statistical inference - our teams turn terabytes of data into innovative trading ideas that move markets.At Graviton Research Capital, we believe our people are our true edge. We’re a collective of engineers, quants, and innovators who thrive on solving complex problems and pushing the boundaries of technology and trading strategy.As the Lead - Talent Management & Development, you’ll build a brand-new function at Graviton from the ground up, bringing together talent management, organisation development and learning & development for a team of engineers, quants, and innovators. You’ll report to the Chief People Officer and work closely with business leaders and HRBPs to make talent development a core part of how Graviton operates as we continue our journey of global expansion.Key Pointers On The Role :Partner with HRBPs and Business to design and execute Graviton’s talent management, organisation development and learning agenda.Identify distinct talent cohorts - critical top performers, high-potentials and the broader base. Build differentiated paths: stretch and recognition to keep our best growing, and a credible route for others to earn their way in.Build succession plans and high-potential frameworks for critical roles across research, technology and support functions, keeping bench strength strong as we scale.Design career paths and growth frameworks - including technical tracks that reflect how our quants, researchers, and engineers actually want to grow.Build Graviton’s learning charter end-to-end, from onboarding to leadership development, partnering with senior leadership as internal faculty.Shape competency frameworks, job architecture, and organisation design as new teams and functions come up.Partner closely with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, and Employee Engagement so talent practices land in day-to-day reality, not just on paper.Hire and build a small, sharp team to scale this function over time, starting with a mid-level Talent Management & Development specialist.What We’re Looking For:10+ years of HR experience, with a strong track record leading talent management, organisation development, or learning & development.Experience building a function or major people programs from scratch, not just running existing ones.Ideally, exposure to designing talent programs for technical, quant, or other high-performance environments.A postgraduate degree in HR from a top-tier B-school.Data-driven mindset with sharp business acumen.Ability to partner effectively and earn credibility with senior technical leaders.Comfort operating in a flat, fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment.We’re looking for someone who’s genuinely energised by building something from scratch - someone who thrives at the intersection of talent, technology, and organisational excellence, and who wants to design programs that actually work for brilliant, sceptical, technical minds. At Graviton, you’ll lead the function that shapes how we grow, retain, and develop the people behind our trading and research edge, as part of a team that’s redefining what great HR looks like in a world-class quant environment. job.rawText: About Vizzard Vizzard is a retention-first, AI-powered software platform for the health and wellness industry. It brings together the tools salons, spas and wellness businesses need to manage their day-to-day operations, stay connected with customers and keep them coming back - all in one place. About the Role We're looking for a Sales Executive to manage the full sales cycle, from qualifying leads and giving product demos to closing the sale and collecting payment. You'll speak with business owners, understand their requirements, explain how Vizzard can help, handle questions and objections, and follow up until the sale is complete. Sales Interns will support you with lead qualification, scheduling and follow-ups, while the Customer Success team takes over once the customer account is activated. What You'll Do Qualify fresh inbound leads and understand their business requirements. Conduct live product demos for qualified inbound and outbound opportunities. Explain Vizzard's plans, pricing and how the product fits the prospect's business. Handle objections, negotiate within approved terms and follow up until closure. Work towards defined monthly sales and revenue targets. Collect payments and initiate new customer accounts after a successful sale. Keep opportunities, follow-ups, payments and sales records accurately updated. Complete a clear handoff to Customer Success once the account is activated. What We're Looking For 6+ months of experience in B2B, SaaS, telesales or similar sales roles. Strong English and Hindi communication with confidence on calls and video. Comfortable giving product demos and selling software to business owners. Good at understanding requirements, pitching solutions and handling objections. Confident with follow-ups, negotiation and closing sales. Organized, target-driven and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Bonus: Ability to communicate in Kannada, Telugu or Malayalam. How Success Is Measured Lead-to-Sale Conversion Rate Sales Target Achievement Demo-to-Sale Conversion Rate The role includes a structured sales commission and performance incentive plan, shared during the offer process. Pay: From ₹10,000.00 per month Benefits: Paid time off Work from home Application Question(s): Review our website https://vizzard.app and tell us in 1 sentence what you think our product is? What's your expected salary? Experience: SaaS sales: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurugram, Haryana 122004
